pass10_context: P10-U7T makes each Level 3 through 30B canonical shell present as one visual card like Levels 1 and 2. It keeps every legacy functional member, selector, control, readiness gate, hidden mount sentinel, and event-driven ownership node in place; only the redundant inner wrapper and repeated direct level heading are visually contained. The Pass 9 Locked / waiting fail-closed readiness state is preserved. The repair does not read, write, delete, migrate, or activate persisted data.
rule: The root trust anchor cannot verify its own pre-execution bytes; it carries the exact digest for the deterministic protected runtime source set.
